{{Locations|Civilian Sector|Engi Controlled Sector|Engi Homeworlds|Rebel Controlled Sector|Rebel Stronghold|LRSmap=ship|unique=true}}


''You stumble across a forward scout of the Rebel fleet.''
* Fight a [[Rebel Ships|Rebel ship]] that is '''running away'''. <!-- Enemy ship - SQUAT_WARNING. Datafile - events_ships.xml -->{{SurrenderEscape|timer|40}}{{SurrenderEscape|surrenderno}}
** ''They are powering up their FTL! If they get away, they will no doubt warn the fleet of your position!''
*** {{Winning|gotaway=true|The scout jumps away. They are sure to have informed the fleet of your position. You must get to the next Sector as soon as possible!}}
**** Rebel Fleet <span style="color:red">pursuit</span> is <span style="color:red">doubled</span>.
*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|Their ship breaks apart and you are relieved to know that you are still one step ahead of the fleet.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|Their ship goes silent and you are relieved to know that you are still one step ahead of the fleet.}}
**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "SQUAT_WARNING" in the datafiles.
